description: The SHOW_INITIAL_ROWS option on CREATE STREAM, across the whole option grid: TRUE, FALSE, alongside APPEND_ONLY in either ORDER, on its own, absent entirely (the older syntax stays accepted), with no options at all, and combined with a COMMENT. Two streams over the same table may carry different SHOW_INITIAL_ROWS values, all four APPEND_ONLY-by-SHOW_INITIAL_ROWS combinations are accepted, IF NOT EXISTS is idempotent so a repeated CREATE leaves exactly ONE stream, and a schema-qualified CREATE puts the stream in THAT schema - so it is only listed by SHOW STREAMS IN SCHEMA, since the session's current schema is PUBLIC. Converted 1:1 from stream/StreamShowInitialRowsTest (now retired), which was a JDBC test that scanned the SHOW STREAMS ResultSet row by row for a name; each such scan is expressed here as a COUNT over RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID()) filtered on the quoted lowercase name column, which asserts the same thing including the uppercase normalisation the class's own helper documented.

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE products (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR, price INTEGER)
CREATE STREAM products_stream ON TABLE products SHOW_INITIAL_ROWS = TRUE
CREATE TABLE customers (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR)
CREATE STREAM customers_stream ON TABLE customers SHOW_INITIAL_ROWS = FALSE
CREATE TABLE orders (id INTEGER, amount INTEGER)
CREATE STREAM orders_stream ON TABLE orders APPEND_ONLY = TRUE SHOW_INITIAL_ROWS = TRUE
CREATE TABLE inventory (item VARCHAR, quantity INTEGER)
CREATE STREAM inventory_stream ON TABLE inventory SHOW_INITIAL_ROWS = TRUE
CREATE TABLE events (id INTEGER, event_type VARCHAR)
CREATE STREAM events_stream ON TABLE events SHOW_INITIAL_ROWS = TRUE APPEND_ONLY = TRUE
CREATE TABLE logs (id INTEGER, message VARCHAR)
CREATE STREAM logs_stream ON TABLE logs APPEND_ONLY = TRUE
CREATE TABLE activity (id INTEGER, action VARCHAR)
CREATE STREAM activity_stream ON TABLE activity
CREATE TABLE transactions (id INTEGER, amount INTEGER)
CREATE STREAM transactions_stream ON TABLE transactions SHOW_INITIAL_ROWS = TRUE COMMENT = 'Transaction change stream'
CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER, username VARCHAR)
CREATE STREAM IF NOT EXISTS users_stream ON TABLE users SHOW_INITIAL_ROWS = TRUE
CREATE STREAM IF NOT EXISTS users_stream ON TABLE users SHOW_INITIAL_ROWS = TRUE
CREATE TABLE sales (id INTEGER, product VARCHAR, amount INTEGER)
CREATE STREAM sales_stream_with_initial ON TABLE sales SHOW_INITIAL_ROWS = TRUE
CREATE STREAM sales_stream_without_initial ON TABLE sales SHOW_INITIAL_ROWS = FALSE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID())) WHERE "name" IN ('SALES_STREAM_WITH_INITIAL', 'SALES_STREAM_WITHOUT_INITIAL')
CREATE TABLE test_table (id INTEGER, data VARCHAR)
CREATE STREAM stream1 ON TABLE test_table APPEND_ONLY = TRUE SHOW_INITIAL_ROWS = TRUE
CREATE STREAM stream2 ON TABLE test_table APPEND_ONLY = TRUE SHOW_INITIAL_ROWS = FALSE
CREATE STREAM stream3 ON TABLE test_table APPEND_ONLY = FALSE SHOW_INITIAL_ROWS = TRUE
CREATE STREAM stream4 ON TABLE test_table APPEND_ONLY = FALSE SHOW_INITIAL_ROWS = FALSE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID())) WHERE "name" IN ('STREAM1', 'STREAM2', 'STREAM3', 'STREAM4')
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS stream_schema
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE stream_schema.data_table (id INTEGER, value VARCHAR)
CREATE OR REPLACE STREAM stream_schema.data_stream ON TABLE stream_schema.data_table SHOW_INITIAL_ROWS = TRUE
